note: Status per requirement: proposed | implemented | validated | deployed | workload-proven. implemented/validated+ cite enforcing code, tests, and exact evidence keys. proposed is owed work, never a claim.

requirements.text: PB decides admission, placement, claim, retry, withdrawal, cleanup.
PB moves bytes and publishes/retires tier residency; PQ declares work/readsets/progress. No parallel dispatcher/cache/scheduler.
Contract is target plus status ledger; proposed is owed work, not a claim.
Action identity is content hash of sealed action.
Attempts keyed (action_key, nonce, scope_id); results adopted per action per INV-08.

requirements.enforcement: pbrun seal path; CAS request index
requirements.text: Manifest wire identity is SHA-256 over sealed file bytes.
Manifest canonical identity via one producer seal function; raw-vs-seal comparisons forbidden.
Payload carries identity plus trust mode staged-verified | pool-declared; staged-only consumers refuse pool-declared unopened.
All residency statements epoch-qualified; epoch change invalidates readiness.
Ranges are half-open [offset,end), tile without overlap, entry-aligned.
Lease (lease_id, holder, tier, epoch, range, acquired_unix) is the unit of pin-while-reading.
Behavior attributed per (runtime_commit, generation_id); source merge alone is not deployed support.
Terminal executed attests run-to-exit-0 only; artifact correctness needs identity checks plus application gates.
Action lifecycle submitted->waiting->admitted->running->terminal with named durable record per transition.

requirements.enforcement: stage_move.py + tier loop (movers/ receipts, map fragments, ledger)
requirements.text: Materialization absent->copying->published->retiring->absent with rename-before-publish and epoch invalidation.
Reader lease acquisition/use/release with bounded wait-or-fail on unpublished ranges; no pool fallback for bulk input.
Admitted resources fit aggregate real lifetimes; concluded on both ledgers via one release helper.

requirements.evidence: PB denial reasons residency_lead_not_resident vs residency_lead_terminal, live tier loop
requirements.text: Claim requires declared initial working set ready (executed + same-manifest + token-pinned leads; adoption counts; no-byte cache_hit does not).
GPU-consumed bulk input opens only RAM or explicitly-allowed SSD staged objects; HDD opens forbidden.
Open path records serving tier per byte before payload trust; after-read counters are not authorization.
Lease acquisition prefers valid RAM then explicitly-allowed SSD.

requirements.enforcement: residency_map.py whole-map refusal on mismatch (implemented); pool-fallback on miss (gap)
requirements.text: Stale-epoch/corrupt/missing data never falls back to HDD; waits boundedly or fails clearly.

requirements.enforcement: stage_move.py owner-keyed temps + atomic rename; egress ownership lane (other worker, open review)
requirements.text: Copy/publish/lease/release serialize safely; last reader incl. pending copy handoff blocks eviction.

requirements.enforcement: checkpoint journal re-verify grammar; attempt nonces
requirements.text: Retries never double-count; checkpoint adoption verifies identity/trust without recompute.
Durable units monotonic and once; replays idempotent.

requirements.enforcement: PQ joint_quanta_join.py coverage + gapped-join semantics (application side, referenced)
requirements.test: PQ join suites (referenced, not re-proven here)
requirements.text: Failed/gapped outputs never publish campaign success; consumers refuse gapped payloads.
Eligibility is class-tag conjunction; host-pair tags admitting neither box are plan errors refused at dispatch.
Checkpoint adoption caps trust at source mode; adopted pool-declared never becomes staged-verified.
Compute progress is not proof of reader release; eviction needs lease state.
Exact read plan with repeats; lookahead fit proven pre-admission or unsupported-workset refused.

requirements.enforcement: pool.py: residency_verdict pending paths; mover retry/timeout policy
requirements.text: Later phases wait boundedly with named reason; consumer holds only current window (no circular hold-and-wait).
Admit on proven next-window fit or terminal unsupported-workset refusal; no silent HDD streaming of missing windows.
No whole-working-set RAM-fit requirement; windows are the unit of fit.
Dev mode disables giant input/output resealing and per-unit source walks.
Missing/changed evidence never triggers hidden whole-model hashing; report dev_uncertified with missing evidence named.
Small manifest-binding checks and integrity-on-copy always on, distinct from expensive sealing.
Every dev result carries dev_uncertified plus executing-tree digest; certified gate unchanged.
Cross-host source-identity cheap check; until then same-host re-verification.
No eviction of a live lease.
No bulk-input read from a forbidden tier.

requirements.enforcement: pool.py: terminal + CAS receipt publication rules

requirements.text: No false complete: terminal success needs exit 0 plus identity verification; wrapper exit/shard counts complete nothing.
Fair eligible workers plus finite I/O plus fitting workset lead to advancement or a named bounded failure.
Schema plus real-producer parser fixtures incl. gzip/path/serialization variants.
PB lifecycle state-machine/property/race tests incl. staged-lease races.
Thin actual-PB-storage plus real-reader chain proving bytes, effective tier, zero forbidden opens.
Restart/retry incl. lease-crash cases: single adoption, no double-count, re-verified bytes.
Both-Spark real placement plus per-box results.
Real campaign output staged-only with bytes_from_pool==0 on bulk legs plus application gates green.
